verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents first-party webhooks across several products. Wallet webhooks deliver real-time events such as transfers and signer exports, payment webhooks track order lifecycle and payment status, and authentication webhooks cover user events. One limitation is that the Agent Checkouts product has no webhooks in v1 and relies on polling. Missing for 10: webhooks for agent checkouts, documented details on endpoint registration, signature verification, and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
